summary: 10 film announcements, 7 TV announcements across 5 trades.

film.title: Leprechaun
film.announcement: New horror film in development from Lionsgate with writers Patrick Melton and Marcus Dunstan attached.

film.title: The Legend of Zelda
film.announcement: Lydia Peckham cast in the live-action film adaptation of The Legend of Zelda.

film.title: Drifter
film.talent: Kate Beckinsale, Dermot Mulroney, Robert Knepper, Sticky Fingaz
film.announcement: Action-thriller film with Kate Beckinsale, Dermot Mulroney, Robert Knepper and rapper Sticky Fingaz cast in lead roles.

film.title: Dedicated to Morris Burke
film.announcement: Da'Vine Joy Randolph cast to star in indie dark comedy from director Will Ropp.

film.title: Blur
film.announcement: Sci-fi action film in development at Netflix with director Kirill Sokolov attached.

film.title: Crawl 2
film.announcement: Paramount has greenlit a sequel to Crawl with Mason Gooding and Emily Rudd set to star.

film.title: Descendants: Hidden Heroes
film.announcement: Disney's Descendants universe expands with a new film following the children of sidekicks from Aladdin, The Emperor's New Groove and other films.

film.title: Everything Else Is Noise
film.announcement: Pragda acquires distribution for Nicolás Pereda's film ahead of Toronto and New York Film Festival premieres.

film.title: Wonka 2
film.announcement: Warner Bros. and the screenwriter clarify that Wonka 2 is not delayed indefinitely and remains in development.

film.title: The Gallerist
film.announcement: Sundance 2026 film with Natalie Portman and Jenna Ortega acquired by Roadside Attractions and Vertical.

tv.title: Gravesend
tv.announcement: Season 3 trailer reveals Vincent Pastore's final TV role and Shaquille O'Neal's debut in the series.

tv.title: Sherlock's Secretary
tv.announcement: Psych creator Andy Berman is eyeing a return to USA Network with a new procedural series in development.

tv.title: Heated Rivalry
tv.announcement: Season 2 casting announced with Justice Smith and Charlie Gillespie as Harris and Troy; Season 2 debut confirmed for Spring 2027.

tv.title: New York Yankees Drama Series
tv.announcement: Netflix is developing a drama series about the New York Yankees from Jason Bateman's Aggregate Films, Josh Wakely, and MLB.

tv.title: The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives
tv.announcement: Series renewed for 20 additional episodes following season-ending drama involving Taylor Frankie Paul.

tv.title: Paradise
tv.announcement: Season 2 finale airs with director Hanelle M. Culpepper discussing the sci-fi series' attention to detail.

tv.title: Sugar
tv.announcement: Season 2 of the Colin Farrell series receives positive reviews.
